description: This file defines a utility class 'Utilities' with static methods for geometric calculations, filename conversions, drawing graphics, and PSI (Program Structure Interface) element retrieval, used within Android Studio plugin development.

classes.name: Utilities
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for geometric calculations, filename conversions, drawing graphics, and PSI element retrieval within Android Studio plugin development.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a new Point that is the sum of two points.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Returns a new Point that is the difference between two points.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Calculates the Euclidean length of a point vector.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns a Point with maximum x and y from two points.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scales a Point or Dimension by a float factor.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Snaps a coordinate to the nearest multiple of a grid size.

methods.name: midPoint
methods.description: Calculates the midpoint between two points or the midpoint of a dimension.

methods.name: point
methods.description: Converts a Dimension to a Point.

methods.name: dimension
methods.description: Converts a Point to a Dimension.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Projects a point onto a rectangle, maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: centre
methods.description: Returns the center point of a rectangle.

methods.name: getXmlFileNameFromJavaFileName
methods.description: Converts a Java filename to an Android-style XML filename.

methods.name: getJavaFileNameFromXmlFileName
methods.description: Converts an XML filename to a Java-style filename.

methods.name: drawArrow
methods.description: Draws an arrow between two points with specified line width.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Returns a Condition that is the negation of the given condition.

methods.name: instanceOf
methods.description: Returns a Condition that checks if an object is an instance of a given class.

methods.name: sign
methods.description: Returns the sign of an integer (-1, 0, 1).

methods.name: notNull
methods.description: Returns a non-null Dimension, defaulting to ZERO_SIZE if null.

methods.name: getPsiClass
methods.description: Retrieves a PsiClass by name within a module.

methods.name: findMethodBySignature
methods.description: Finds a method in a class by its signature.

methods.name: createMethodFromText
methods.description: Creates a PsiMethod from text within a project or class context.

methods.name: virtualFile
methods.description: Finds a VirtualFile corresponding to a File.
